name: Bowman Orchards
tagline: Apple Picking & More in Clifton Park NY
description: Bowman Orchards is an on-farm market in 141 Sugar Hill Road, NY, selling produce straight from the field. Because everything is sold where it is grown, selection follows the local harvest calendar. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
